description.content: Returns the most recent Starbridge signals (bridge rows) for a given buyer within the organization. A signal pairs a bridge (the monitoring definition) with a row (a concrete match). Supports filtering by bridge ids, bridge filter types, row statuses, and a relative date period. Default sort is by signal date (most recent first); pass sort=Hotness to rank by hotness score. All sorts are descending.

query.description: Limit results to signals from these bridge ids.
Sort field. Date = by signal date, Hotness = by hotness score. Always descending. Date is the default.
(Required) UUID of the buyer whose signals to return.
Filter by row status. Defaults to New when omitted.
Lower bound on the signal date as a relative period.

response.name: Paginated list of recent signals for the buyer.
